question.text: The IRDAI was constituted under which Act, and the Authority comprises how many members?

explanation.text: The Logic: IRDAI was constituted by an Act of Parliament - the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (IRDA) Act, 1999. Section 4 of the IRDA Act, 1999 provides for ten government-appointed members on the Authority. The Trap: The Insurance Act, 1938 governs the substantive law of insurance business but does not constitute IRDAI as a body. Companies Act and SEBI Act govern different regulators / domains. Note: Page 31 of the workbook supports both the constituting Act and the ten-member composition under Section 4. The Authority is distinct from the regulators (RBI, SEBI, PFRDA) that handle other parts of the financial system.
